source.description: Manager-visible starting-XI clipboard export from the running FM Analytics tactic page.
notes: The exact 11 selected players, IDs, ages, familiarity and visible attributes are preserved.
positions stores the displayed lineup position; lineupSlots preserves the selected slot.
Unavailable, injured or suspended players were excluded by the source selector.
Readiness, dates of birth, contracts and preferred feet were not exported and remain null.
Manager identity and club ID were not exported; fixture identifiers are explicit placeholders.
Attribute groups outside the clipboard export are explicitly unknown, even when the live source could supply them.
